text:
vivian: Quick follow-up on private/VPC CP split: can we let the tenant connector terminate mTLS inside customer VPC and only use a shared relay for emergency egress? Main fears: SNAT IP exhaustion and cert lifecycle.

samir: I like the model but we need guardrails. Proposed graduated fallback: transient (<30s) = retry, short (30s-5m) = queue + background recon, sustained (>5m) = route to shared-relay with per-tenant caps.

nora: Ops: set default per-tenant concurrent relayed flows=5, idle reclaim=10m, soft SNAT alert=70%, hard stop=95%. Also emit reason codes: agent_unreachable, cert_expired, nat_quota.

ops-bot: infra: canary scheduled: 50 tenants in eu-west-1. Auto-rollback if snat_pool_util > 0.8 for >5m.

eathan: Security: no long-lived bootstrap tokens. Use OIDC->short-lived cert (24h). CP keeps tiny verification proxy for handshake only. Add `/health/egress` on agent returning status+fallback_count, e.g.:

```
{"status":"degraded","fallback_count":1}
```

vivian: Actions: samir draft fallback policy doc, nora add alert rules and reclaim loop, ethan prototype OIDC bootstrap. If no objections by EOD we'll spin a spike branch. :thumbsup:
